pr_title: fix: hide cal branding for orgs/teams
query: We pay for the plan that takes the vendor's own name and logo off what our attendees see. The page people book on respects that, but the mark is still there on confirmation and reminder messages, on the code-verification message sent before a booking is taken, and after a paid booking goes through. It also behaves one way for a team event and another way for an ordinary member's own event.
